description:
START HERE for 'how many calls or credits do I have left'. COST: free, no API key required, and it does not count against the keyless 10 calls per day (it is subject to the per-minute pace limit like every call). Returns your tier (keyless, free, starter, pro, enterprise or agent), calls used and remaining for the current window (daily for keyless, monthly for plans), profile pulls (pulls_used, pulls_limit, pulls_remaining and when that window resets, pulls_resets_at; a pull is one get_fund call or one LP row from search_lps), credits remaining for agent keys, when the call window resets (resets_at), and your per-minute pace limit. Never charges anything.
Cost: free
name: get_usage
title: Get my usage and limits
